chunks: And in the narration of Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Abān, that Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:

Regarding a man who divorced with two divorces in good health, then pronounced the third divorce while he was ill: she inherits from him so long as he remains in his illness, even if it is up to a year.
ai.seo_question: Does a thrice-divorced wife inherit from a husband who pronounces the final divorce during his terminal illness?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a man who completed the third divorce while in a state of illness after having issued the first two divorces in good health. It states that the divorced woman still inherits from him as long as he remains in that illness, even if the illness continues for up to a year.
